text:
Alex W: Quick async update — planning to flip the hotpath kernel v2.3 canary tonight (23:00 PT). Landing PRs: #8427 (kernel scheduler), #8431 (batch merge), and #8440 (kv-prefetch). Need owners to ack rollback criteria + perf gating. cc @Tina C @Raj P

Tina C: Ack from me. Which metric should gate? p50 or p95? and do we require steady-state for 10m or 5m?

Raj P: p95 tail matters most for interactive flows. Recommend p95 < 85ms and no error spike > 0.5% over 5m. Also FYI eng-infra change (PR #4212) on kernel cgroup limits needs to be green otherwise canary may throttle.

Sylvie L: KV cache change in #8440 increases prefetch multiplier to 2.0 — I ran a quick experiment on staging and saw token throughput +8% but a modest increase in mem pressure. Suggest we watch evictions and per-shard queue depth.

Alex W: Good — use p95 <85ms, 5m window. Rollback if errors >0.5% or evictions spike > 10% from baseline. Can folks add these checks to the canary dashboard? Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/canary/8427

Tina C: I'll add the p95 and error-rate panels. Can someone post the baseline numbers?

Raj P: Baseline p95 for hotpath (prod) ~72ms, error-rate steady 0.12%, eviction rate ~1.8%. I'll push these to the dashboard in 10m.

ops-bot: CI: kernel-scheduler-tests — passed; batch-merge-tests — passed; kv-prefetch-tests — flaky (2/5). See: https://ci.redwood.internal/8427/logs

Sylvie L: Noted flaky tests. The kv unit test failure seems related to timing in prefetch backoff. I'll add a retry in the test harness and open a follow-up PR if that stabilizes.

Alex W: For rollout ownership: Tina — monitoring & rollback checks; Raj — infra gating & baseline publishing; Sylvie — kv canary instrumentation & test fix. If anyone else wants ownership overlap, speak now.

Tina C: I'll also own alert runbooks. I'll update runbooks with rollback commands and quick queries.

Raj P: I'll coordinate with eng-infra on PR #4212. If eng-infra asks to delay, we'll hold the canary until they confirm limits.

Sylvie L: I'll post the canary trace template (span names, tags we need) in this thread in a sec.

Sylvie L: ```trace template
service=hotpath-kernel
span=kernel.batch.process
tags=[kv_prefetch=enabled, batch_size, shard_id]
query=duration>200ms
```

Alex W: Nice. One more ask — code review pings: please review #8427 and #8440 by 17:00 PT so we can merge earlier and give infra time to validate. @everyone :thumbsup: if you're good with schedule.

Tina C: :thumbsup: reviewing now.

Raj P: :thumbsup: have a quick infra check later today.

ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window reserved 23:00-00:30 PT. No other hot deploys scheduled.

Alex W: Perfect. I'll post a final pre-canary checklist 30m before rollout. Thanks all — will follow up with links to canary runbook and PR diffs.
